User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to create a billing run

So that I will have possibility to create an invoices for specific customers based on pre-validated contract/order data and consumption data

Design:https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ba3f8f8-3091-4853-bd9d-0f490b8b6df4-6ef0/

 

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Creating a correction of invoices for a Billing run is possible from the Billing run's listing page by clicking on a 'Plus' button

  2. Check system user permission to be able to create a new billing run

    1. Permission - Create a Billing Run

    2. Enable Plus button when user has permission

    3. Disable Plus button when user doesn’t have permission

  3. Creation page contains three individual tabs:

    1. Basic Parameters (Only visible in creation)

    2. Draft invoice (will be visible after starting billing)

    3. PDF documents (will be visible after starting PDF document generation)

  4. Invoice correction will be loaded after selecting Billing run type 'Invoice correction'

    1. Billing Type

      1. Mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown with hardcoded values:

        1. Standard billing

        2. Manual invoice

        3. Manual credit or debit note

        4. Invoice correction

        5. Manual interim and advance payment

        6. Reversal of invoice

        7. Invoice correction (will be selected)

  5. Basic Parameters tab:

    1. Checkboxes for defining stages of the Billing Run

      1. Optional

      2. Generate and Signing

        1. If this option is selected, it means that system should generate draft invoices and without any confirmation should automatically generate PDF documents and sign them. However, in order to create a Real invoices, confirmation is needed

        2. Billing run’s status should be changed as ‘In Progress Draft’ after starting Draft invoices generation

        3. Billing run’s status should be changed as ‘Draft’ after completed all Draft invoice generation

        4. Billing run’s status should be changed as ‘In Progress Generation’ when PDF documents generation starts

        5. Billing run’s status should be changed as ‘Generated’ When PDF documents generation is completed

        6. Confirmation is possible from the Pop-up window

      3. Automatically Accounting

        1. If only this option is selected, it means that in order to create a Real invoices, confirmation is not needed. However, in order generating a PDF documents and sign them, confirmation is needed

        2. Billing run’s status should be changed as ‘In Progress Accounting’ when real invoices generation is started

        3. Billing run’s status should be changed as ‘Completed’ When real invoices are generated

        4. Confirmation is possible from the Pop-up window

      4. If both checkboxes are selected

        1. it means that draft invoices will be generated without confirmation, PDF documents will be generated and signed without confirmation and Real invoices will be created also without confirmation

      5. if none of them is selected

        1. Additional confirmation is needed for generate PDF documents and then additional confirmation is needed to create real invoices

        2. Confirmation is possible from the Pop-up window

    2. Number

      1. Text field

      2. Always disabled

      3. Number is automatically generate by the system

      4. Unique identifier of the billing run

      5. Hardcoded prefix: Billing

      6. Format: BILLLINGYYYYMMDDXXXX

        1. For example: BILLING202311280001

        2. In the given example 2023 is the current year, 11 is the current month and 28 is the current day. 0001 is a unique number for each billing run which should be generated by the system

      7. It is not possible to have a gap in the 4 digit number

        1. For example: BILLING121420230203  is not allowed

      8. Counter for different types of billing runs are the same

      9. If user deletes already created billing run, and creates another one in the same day, system should take into consideration already created billing run’s number

        1. For example, BILLING12142023001 is deleted, number for the second billing run should be BILLING12142023002

    3. Status

      1. Text field

      2. On creation always empty and disabled

      3. On Editing mode, also disabled and empty, as status is always changed automatically by the system

      4. Hardcoded values:

        1. Initial

        2. In Progress Draft

        3. Draft

        4. In Progress Generation

        5. Generated

        6. In Progress Accounting

        7. Completed

        8. Deleted

        9. Paused

        10. Cancelled

      5. When Billing run is created and the billing process is not started immediately, it means that status should be Initial

      6. When Billing run is created and the billing process is started immediately, it means that status should be In Progress Draft

        1. When process is started automatically, billing run’s status should be changed as In Progress Draft

      7. When Draft invoices generation is completed for the Billing run, its status should be Draft

      8. When PDF documents generation starts status should be changed as Progress Generation

      9. When PDF documents generating process is completed and signed for the Billing run, its status should be Generated

      10. When generating of Real invoices is started for the billing run, its status should be changed as In Progress Accounting

      11. When Real invoices generation process is completed for the billing run, its status should be Completed

      12. When Task connection type is defined as Internal, system should allow creating task and it should be possible to add only Activity sub-object to it (all other sub-objects should be disabled)

      13. When Billing run is deleted, its status should be Deleted

        1. It is possible to delete a billing run when its status is initial

        2. It is possible to delete billing run from its listing/Preview

      14. Billing run status can be changed as paused. Pause can be happened when billing run status is:

        1. In Progress Draft

        2. Draft

        3. In Progress Generation

        4. Generated

        5. In Progress Accounting

      15. Billing run status can be changed as cancelled. Cancel can be happened when billing run is:

        1. In Progress Draft

        2. Draft

        3. In Progress Generation

        4. Generated

        5. In Progress Accounting

        6. Pause

    4. Sending an invoice

      1. Mandatory

      2. Radio button with three hardcoded values:

        1. According to the contract

          1. Preselected by default

        2. Sending an invoice

        3. Email

      3. When 'According to the contract' option is selected, it means that system should generate a separate invoices for each customer (defined in the contracts); Should be checked if in billing group is added alternative customer, should be used this customer

      4. When 'Email' option is selected, it means that system should generate a separate invoices for each customer (communication data for billing)

      5. When 'Paper' option is selected, it means that system should generate one general PDF with all invoices created within this billing run and additionally, should create a separate invoice documents for each invoice.

    5. Accounting period

      1. Mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown

        1. Accounting Periods should be displayed with its number

        2. It is possible to search accounting period in its number

        3. Will be possible to search by number latest created should be visible first

      3. By default, current month's accounting period should be set

      4. It is possible to change the accounting period and select it from the past (For example, if the current month is November and user selects September's accounting period for a billing run, we can choose all Accounting periods , which have “Open” status)

      5. It is not possible to choose closed accounting period for a billing run

        1. System shouldn’t display closed accounting periods in the dropdown

    6. Invoice date

      1. Mandatory

      2. Date picker

      3. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

      4. Data should be displayed in between 01.01.1990 to 31.12.2090

      5. By default, current day should be set, but it is possible to change the date and choose another day from the past or future

      6. Invoice Date must be within the period of the Accounting period

    7. Tax event date

      1. Mandatory

      2. Date picker

      3. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

      4. Data should be displayed in between 01.01.1990 to 31.12.2090

      5. By default, a current day should be set, but it is possible to change the date and choose another day from the past or future

      6. If the user chooses the past date, the date should be in selected accounting period.

      7. For example, the billing run is connected with the accounting period (February 2024), in the tax event date the system user can choose 1 February, the date which is earlier than February should be impossible to choose

    8. Additional information

      1. Text area

      2. Optional

      3. Length 2048 symbols

      4. All symbols are allowed

    9. Change: (At least one should be selected, If it is not selected > return error)

      1. Price change

        1. Checkbox

        2. Unselected by default

        3. when user selects ONLY Price change > Importing invoices as excel AND also in field should be mandatory. (at least one of them)

          ALSO, if excel file is empty, should return error

      2. Volume Change

        1. Checkbox

        2. Unselected by default

        3. When only Volume change is selected, the correction billing run must still use the Group of price components version that applies to the billing period from the original invoice billing data and must calculate all price components from that version (including price components added in a newer applicable group version, for example Data by scales components). Such price components must be included on generated correction invoices (including ÐÐÐ).

    10. Type of execution:

      1. Mandatory

      2. Dropdown with hardcodes values:

        1. Immediate

        2. Certain date

        3. Manual

    11. Execution Date

      1. Enabled and mandatory if type of execution is Certain date

      2. Disable and empty if type of execution is ‘immediate’ and manual

      3. Date picker

      4. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

      5. It is possible the date to be current day or in the future

      6. It is not possible to choose date from the past

    12. Execution Time

      1. Enabled and mandatory if type of execution is Certain date

      2. Disable and empty if type of execution is ‘immediate’ and manual

      3. Disable if type of execution is ‘immediate’

        1. Text field

        2. Allowed symbols: 0-9

        3. Length: 5 characters

        4. Format: 13:00

        5. Written time should be more than current time if execution date is current day

          1. For example: if user select current day in the date and it's 14:00, time in this field should be more than 14:00

          2. If the chosen date is in the future in then there is no need to check time to the current hour

    13. List of invoices

      1. Text box

      2. Optional

        1. Mandatory if import file is not uploaded and user clicks on Save button

      3. Length: 1-2048 characters

      4. Display a scrollbar if selected items exceed 2 lines

      5. Allowed symbols: All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

      6. It is possible to manually write a numbers of real invoices in this box and after clicking on a Save button of an object, those invoices will be cancelled

      7. User should write invoice numbers in text box divided  by commas

        1. For example: FP0005265895, FP0005265857

      8. System should trim the intervals and take invoice number between the commas for correction

      9. It is possible to delete already written invoice number from the text box before clicking on Save button

      10. Minimum number of the invoice numbers written in the text box should be 1

      11. In the list of invoice number, the correction process will happen with the last created invoice number, which we indicated in the list

    14. Import Functionality

      1. Choose file button

        1. optional

        2. It is possible to upload a xlsx file from the compute for import

        3. File should contain a real invoices' numbers

        4. If file structure is correct, after clicking on Save button, system will automatically start invoice cancellation process

        5. If file structure is not correct, after clicking on Save button, system should display an error message

        6. In import case, we can indicate the date, and the correction process will happen with an invoice number, which has the same date

        7. if the date is not indicated, the correction process should choose the last invoice which was created in the system and has the same ID

When only price change is selected, in Invoice list or in import file should be at least one invoice

  1. Download template button

    1. It is possible to download an invoice cancellation template

    2. Invoice cancellation template includes only one column - Invoice Number

    3. After clicking on a Save button, system will automatically start an invoice cancellation process and will display its results in the Processes page in the system settings module

    4. It is possible to upload only one file for each cancellation process

    5. Uploaded file name will be set in the text field

    6. Maximum amount of invoices in the file are not restricted

    7. Minimum amount of invoices for cancellation is 1

    1. Download file button

      1. Enable when file is uploaded

      2. Disable when file is not uploaded

      3. When clicking on this button it should be possible to download already uploaded file from the billing run

    1. Sub-object:

      1. Template

        1. Mandatory

        2. Single select dropdown

        3. It is possible to select a template from the system

        4. Save button - when user finds a needed template and clicks on this button, modal window should be closed, and the template is added to the invoice cancellation page

        5. Cancel button - modal window is closed and user stays on invoice cancellation page

        6. Template will be used for each invoice which was cancelled during the process

        7. It is possible to add more than one template and in this case, all the letters should be generated for each invoice

        8. For example: there are 2 templates attached to the invoice cancellation process and user wants to cancel 10 invoices, system should generated 20 letters (2 for each invoice)

        9. Sending generated documents to the customer

        10. Maximum amount of the templated are not restricted

      2. Billing errors protocols

        1. Disabled

        2. File is generated automatically by the system and attached to the billing run

        3. File format: xlsx file

        4. System will generate one file for each billing run

        5. Errors which will be found while generating a Draft invoices

        6. Errors can be general errors for billing and informational errors

        7. For general errors it is not possible to generate an invoice

        8. For informational errors it is possible to generate an invoice

      3. Accounting errors protocols

        1. Disabled

        2. File is generated automatically by the system and attached to the billing run

        3. File format: xlsx file

        4. System will generate one file for each billing run

        5. Errors which will be found while generating a Real invoices

        6. Errors can be general errors for billing and informational errors

        7. For general errors it is not possible to generate an invoice

        8. For informational errors it is possible to generate an invoice

      4. Invoices export

        1. Disabled in creation

      5. Tasks

        1. Disable on billing run creation page, only in editing mode it will be possible to add task

        2. When Billing run is started, it is possible to add task to it

        3. Task can be added to in any status of correction

      6. Employee

        1. Disabled

        2. The user which is logged in the system is added automatically by the system as an Employee

        3. It is not possible to add more than one employee to billing run

        4. Not clickable

      7. Start Billing button

      8. Always disable on Billing Run's creation page

      9. If Billing run’s type is Manual, then it is possible to click on Start Billing run button in preview mode

      10. If Billing run’s type is Exact date, it is possible to click on Start Billing Button before that day comes

      11. Clicking on button will start invoice correction process:

        1. https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kendpVDuOKBrhVfBOlfIZA1noeuzUqVi/view?usp=sharing

  2. Draft Invoice's tab:

    1. Draft invoices tab is available only after user clicks on 'Start Billing' button or billing process is started immediately after saving or automatically

    2. Billing run can be started automatically when its type is 'Exact Date' and there is an exact date defined or its type is 'Immediately'

    3. After Billing Run starts, second tab should be displayed with name 'Draft Invoices' which will be generated according to the Billing Run

    4. Maximum number of generated draft invoices are not restricted

    5. Tab contains fields:

      1. Listing

        1. To be able to display a list of generated draft invoices

        2. Newly generated invoices will be listed as last record in the list

        3. In the listing invoices are displayed with following columns:

          1. Number

            1. Number of draft invoices should have prefix and its structure can be: FP-D000000001

          2. Document type

            1. Credit note

          3. Date of invoice

            1. Date in which the invoice was created

          4. Customer

          5. Accounting period

          6. Billing run

          7. Basis for issuing

          8. Meter reading period from

          9. Meter reading period to

          10. Total amount (in default currency)

          11. Action

            1. Edit

            2. Clicking on an edit icon will open draft invoice’s detail page in new browser window

      2. Select all

        1. It is possible to select needed draft invoices and after click on Remove Selected button, they should be marked as red

        2. After draft invoices are generated and they are not made into real invoices, system should delete such invoices for the listing after one month

        3. Calculating of one month should be started from the draft invoices generating date

        4. One month should be defined as 31 days

      3. Search field

        1. It is possible to search draft invoices with its number

      4. Remove Selected button

        1. After invoice(s) are selected in the listing and user clicks on Remove Selected button, they should be marked as red and should not be deleted from the listing until one month is not passed from its creation

      5. Restore Selected button

        1. After invoice(s) are selected in the listing and use clicks on Restore Selected button, they should be unmarked from red and system should generate PDF document for that draft invoices as well

        2. Using this functionality is possible only when billing run’s status is Draft

    6. Pagination

      1. To be able to navigate through next/previous page

      2. To be able to navigate to first/last page

      3. To be able to use arrow back/forward for navigation

      4. To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter will directly load that page

    7. When user clicks on 'Start Generation' button system should generate PDF documents and after process is completed display them in the in the billing run's third tab

      1. When system starts generating PDF documents, billing run's status should be changed as  'In Progress Generated'

      2. When system generated PDF documents, billing run's status should be changed as 'Generated'

      3. If Generate and Signing checkbox is selected, then button should be disabled and process will be started automatically after draft invoices generation process is completed

  3. 'PDF Documents' tab

    1. PDF Documents tab is available only after user clicks on 'Start Generate' button

    2. After Billing Run starts, third tab should be displayed with name 'PDF Documents' which will be generated according to the draft invoices

      1. Maximum number of generated PDF Documents are not restricted

      2. Deleted draft invoices shouldn’t be generated as PDF documents

    3. Generated PDF documents should have a real invoice numbers, however it's status should stay as Draft until user clicks on Start Accounting button

    4. If PDF document does not become real invoice, its status should be changed as Cancelled and such record should be displayed in the Invoice listing

    5. Tab contains fields:

      1. Listing

        1. To be able to display a list of generated PDF Documents

        2. Newly generated documents will be listed as last record in the list

        3. In the listing invoices are displayed with following columns:

          1. Number

            1. Number of draft invoices should have prefix and its structure can be: FP-0000000001

          2. Document type

            1. Invoice

            2. Credit note

            3. Debit note

          3. Date of invoice

            1. Date in which the invoice was created

          4. Customer

          5. Accounting period

          6. Billing run

          7. Basis for issuing

          8. Meter reading period from

          9. Meter reading period to

          10. Total amount (in default currency)

          11. Action

            1. Edit

            2. Clicking on an edit icon will open invoice’s detail page in new browser window

      2. Select all

        1. It is possible to select needed documents and after click on Remove Selected button, they should be marked as red

      3. Search field

        1. It is possible to search PDF documents with its number

      4. Remove Selected button

        1. After document(s) are selected in the listing and user clicks on Remove Selected button, they should be marked as red and should not be deleted from the listing

      5. Restore Selected button

        1. After document(s) are selected in the listing and use clicks on Restore Selected button, they should be unmarked from red and system should generate Real invoices for such records

    6. When user clicks on 'Start Accounting' button system should generate real invoices and after process is completed display them in the in the Invoice's listing page

      1. When system starts generating a real invoices, billing run's status should be changed as  'In Progress Real'

      2. When system generated real invoices, billing run's status should be changed as 'Completed'

      3. If Automatically Accounting checkbox is selected, then button should be disabled and process will be started automatically after PDF documents generation process is completed

  4. Clicking on 'Save' button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

    1. If all the validations are successful, the system should start billing run if its type is Immediately,  for any other types, system should create a new record and display it in the listing

    2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

    3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

  5. Clicking on 'Cancel' or 'X' button warning pop-up message comes out 'Are you sure you want to cancel billing run process?' Yes/No

    1. Yes - will close pop-up and user is returned to the previous page

    2. No - will close pop-up and user stays on the current page

    3. Warning message should be managed via system settings

Customer Feedbacks: https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PDT-2886
